meta.note: Section weights are taken from the published ICMAI 2022 curriculum. Per-chapter marks are INDICATIVE only: they are derived by dividing the section weight across the chapters in that section. Always confirm the current syllabus, study material edition and amendments on icmai.in before relying on any figure.

papers.name: Business Laws and Ethics
papers.summary: Commercial law, industrial law, the Companies Act 2013 and business ethics. Commercially weighted, highly predictable paper.
papers.strategy: Companies Act 2013 is 40% of the paper — secure it first. Contracts is the second anchor. Industrial laws are largely memory-based and can be revised in short cycles close to the exam.

papers.name: Financial Accounting
papers.summary: Financial statement preparation, partnership, special transactions and 12 specified Accounting Standards. The backbone for Paper 10 and Paper 18.
papers.strategy: Accounting Standards (20%) and final accounts (20%) are the highest-yield blocks and also the most repeated. Partnership is mechanically predictable — practise admission and retirement full-sums cold.

papers.name: Direct and Indirect Taxation
papers.summary: Half direct tax (income tax computation) and half indirect tax (GST + Customs). The most amendment-sensitive paper in Group I.
papers.strategy: GST at 35% is the single largest block. Direct tax computation is technique: drill the PGBP and salary computations until they are mechanical. Track Finance Act and GST circular amendments every month — this paper punishes stale notes.

chapters.title: Basics of Income Tax Act, 1961
topics: Residential status and incidence of tax

chapters.title: Customs Act and Rules
topics: Valuation of imported and export goods

papers.name: Cost Accounting
papers.summary: Cost ascertainment, methods and techniques. The paper that most distinguishes a CMA and the base for Papers 12, 16 and 17.
papers.strategy: This is a practice paper. Marks come from working notes, not theory. Target 25–30 full-length problems per week from Chapter 2, 5 and 6. Learn the 24 Cost Accounting Standards for the theory block.

topics: Cost accounting vs financial accounting vs management accounting

Primary and secondary distribution, reciprocal services
Absorption of overheads and under/over recovery

topics: Cost of production and cost of sales
Joint costs, by-products and abnormal costs

chapters.title: Cost Book Keeping

papers.name: Operations Management and Strategic Management
papers.summary: Operations planning, OR applications, project management and strategy formulation. Heavy on theory plus quantitative OR problems.
papers.strategy: Section A carries 60%, and within it OR/PPC (20%) and project management (15%) are numerical. Strategic management is 40% and is answer-structure driven — practise writing 5-mark structured answers.

chapters.title: Application of Operations Research — Production Planning and Control
Economics of Maintenance and Spares Management

papers.name: Corporate Accounting and Auditing
papers.summary: Company accounts under Schedule III, sector accounts, plus audit concepts and the Companies Act audit provisions.
papers.strategy: Accounting and auditing are 50/50. Schedule III presentation and cash flow statement are near-certain. Audit is where a well-structured answer with standard references scores fastest.

chapters.title: Financial Statements as per Schedule III
Accounts of Banking, Electricity and Insurance Companies
topics: Banking company formats and NPA provisions

papers.name: Financial Management and Business Data Analytics
papers.summary: Financial management (80%) plus business data analytics (20%) — the bridge between the CMA syllabus and the analytics academy in this repository.
papers.strategy: Ratio analysis (15%), capital budgeting (15%) and working capital (15%) are the three biggest blocks. The analytics section is 20% and is comparatively easy marks if you can read a chart and explain a model.

chapters.title: Institutions and Instruments in Financial Markets
Sources of Finance and Cost of Capital
topics: Cost of debt, preference and equity

chapters.title: Introduction to Data Science for Business Decisions

papers.name: Management Accounting
papers.summary: Decision-making tools: marginal costing and CVP, ABC, transfer pricing, standard costing, budgeting, divisional performance and decision theory.
papers.strategy: Marginal costing plus its applications is a combined 30% — the largest single block in the whole Intermediate course. Build decision tables and always present the differential analysis, not just the final number.

chapters.title: Applications of Marginal Costing in Short-term Decisions
